mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback_ticket (id, user_id, type, contact, content, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{contact, javaType=String, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content}, #{status}, 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))

INSERT INTO feedback_ticket_event (id, ticket_id, action, actor_type, actor_id, detail, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ticketId}, #{action}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{detail, javaType=String, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
INSERT INTO feedback_ticket_attachment (id, ticket_id, asset_id, sort_no, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ticketId}, #{assetId}, #{sortNo}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.sql: id, user_id, type, contact, content, status, version, reply, reply_operator_id, created_at, updated_at, replied_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback_ticket WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, action, created_at FROM feedback_ticket_event WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT asset_id AS assetId, sort_no AS sortNo FROM feedback_ticket_attachment WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY sort_no ASC, asset_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback_ticket SET status = 'RESOLVED', version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), reply = #{reply}, reply_operator_id = #{actorId}, replied_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback_command_idempotency (id, request_key, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestKey}, #{canonicalVersion}, #{paramsSha256}, #{paramsCanonical}, 'RESERVED', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_key, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, receipt_json FROM feedback_command_idempotency WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback_command_idempotency SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', receipt_json = #{receiptJson}, succeeded_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} AND status = 'RESERVED'
